perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Fragile Focus

perks.name: Triple Tap

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Triple Tap and Precision Instrument are a match made in heaven. Allow me to do more damage while keeping bullets back? Perfect. If you're a little less accurate or prefer an MLG COD NO SCOPE 420 twitch sensitivity, then maybe Keep Away with Voltshot would be better for you." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Sightlines Survey is a good hand cannon for dueling. Enhanced Precision Instrument will allow you to 3c lower resilience guardians with a blistering fast 0.67 TtK. This will allow you to compete with the likes of 140 and 120 hand cannons." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 106 from 3 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/7jGtQ3pw94PV7XpXREQ094?si=ddb5fb64813048e1) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add clearing in end-game content, particularly when using arc fragments. Shapeable. Sightline Survey is essentially how non-Raiding Guardians can craft a hand cannon with Voltshot. If you already have a Posterity, you can move along! The stats are towards the bottom of comparators although on the plus side, with the frame intrinsic, at least you don't have to worry about recoil direction. Handling could definitely do with a boost from the barrel perk - Fluted Barrel is best, with maybe Corkscrew Rifling instead if that's all the drops. For Voltshot, Reload Speed is key, which is a poor 2.54s at base - hence Flared Magwell (2.29s), or Tactical Mag (2.37s) as the magazine perk and, in the first trait perk column, Enlightened Action. You get three stacks per hit, so four hits will grant +50 Handling and Reload Speed for 2s, reducing reload time to 1.83s. Finally, in the second trait slot, the perk you've been building towards, Voltshot, for fast add-clearing and synergising with arc fragments that use Jolt. The Radiolaria Transposer origin trait is nice to have - the AoE damage isn't huge, but it is additional to weapon damage so what's not to like? Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.
